heading: Severability
lead: If any provision of this part is held to be unconstitutional, the remainder of this part shall not be affected.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 927 of act July 1, 1944, was renumbered section 947, and is classified to section 299c–6 of this title. Another prior section 927 of act July 1, 1944, was classified to section 299c–6 of this title prior to the general amendment of this subchapter by Pub. L. 106–129.

sourceCredit: (July 1, 1944, ch. 373, title IX, § 927, formerly § 926, as added Pub. L. 109–41, § 2(a)(5), July 29, 2005, 119 Stat. 434; renumbered § 927, Pub. L. 111–148, title III, § 3509(e)(1), Mar. 23, 2010, 124 Stat. 534.)
